subject: Problem when deploying apps with large depending packages

messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Problem when deploying apps with large depending packages
parts:
Hi all,
I am now trying to deploy the shinyapps which depends on several large data packages. These packages are all several hundred MB in size, for example this package from Bioconductor http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/html/Affymoe4302Expr.html . There is an error message as follows:


Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 10605...
Waiting for task: 26099908
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 158487
  building: Building package: Affymoe4302Expr
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 26099909 failed: Error building image: Error fetching Affymoe4302Expr (1.3.1) source. Error downloading package source: HTTP 599: Connection closed
Execution halted


I wonder whether shinyapps put a restriction on the maximum size of the depending packages?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem when deploying apps with large depending packages
parts:
If the data is in a package, we are probably hitting a timeout while we try to download and install the package(s).  What packages are you looking for?

For uploads we have a limit of 100MB. We recognize that this is an issue that we will need to resolve for some users.  
There are tricks to download the data sets before your application starts if the file is not there already, but I suspect those aren't helpful for this scenario.  

-Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem when deploying apps with large depending packages
parts:
Jason,

I wanted follow up with on this and let you know I went ahead a fix the issues around downloading/installing very large packages:

> system.time(deployApp("../shinyapps-test/bioc", appName="bioc", account="andy"))
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 40962...
Waiting for task: 28883441
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Fetching packages
  building: Building package: Affymoe4302Expr
  building: Building package: Biobase
  building: Building package: AnnotationDbi
  building: Building package: org.Mm.eg.db
  building: Installing files
  building: Pushing image: 173116
  deploying: Starting instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Application successfully deployed to http://andy.shinyapps.io/bioc
    user   system  elapsed 
  77.247   10.064 2512.854 

We now support downloading / installing packages up to 1GB. However I wanted to note that it seems that the BioConductor repository is performing vey poorly, so it can take some time to build the packages on shinyapps.io, so please be patient.

Let me know if you run into issues.

-Andy
